message:
Running command: cat > /tmp/build_fribidi.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
SRC=/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fribidi
BUILD=/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build
mkdir -p /tmp/fribidi_build
cd /tmp/fribidi_build
for f in $SRC/lib/*.c; do
  gcc -c -O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer \
    -I$SRC/lib -I$BUILD -I$BUILD/lib -I$BUILD/gen.tab -I$SRC \
    -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -DFRIBIDI_ENTRY='__attribute__((visibility("default")))' \
    -o /tmp/fribidi_build/$(basename $f .c).o $f
done
echo "compiled $(ls /tmp/fribidi_build/*.o | wc -l) objects"
EOF
bash /tmp/build_fribidi.sh
